name: Darkspear Mausoleum
prompt_style: Objects are modeled 3D assets from a modern dark-fantasy dungeon-crawler video game (Unreal Engine 5), seen from above, sized correctly for the room, each casting a soft dark contact shadow onto the floor. A dwarven tomb swallowed by jungle: carved dark stone with angular dwarven knotwork, tarnished bronze, thick tree roots, hanging vines, moss, fallen leaves and bear sign (claw marks, tufts of fur, gnawed bones).

1.name: Hall of the Thane
1.art: a long entrance hall: two toppled stone dwarf statues holding spears, thick tree roots breaking through the floor at the edges, drifts of dead leaves, bear claw marks on a fallen stone slab.

2.name: Bear Den
2.art: a bear den: a large nest of torn moss, branches and leaves, piles of gnawed bones and a cracked dwarven shield, tufts of dark fur, a smashed stone urn.

3.name: Defaced Shrine
3.art: a small shrine: a broken stone altar, a dwarven stone face carving smashed on the floor, scattered offering bowls, roots and leaf litter.

4.name: Root Passage
4.art: a short passage choked with thick tree roots along the walls, fallen leaves, a broken bronze lantern.

5.name: Jellied Crypt
5.art: a crypt: three stone burial niches broken open along the walls, a pale translucent green slime puddle in the middle with a dwarf skeleton half dissolved inside it, a silvery mithral breastplate and an ornate gilded rapier on the floor beside it.

6.name: Mourners' Landing
6.art: a small landing: two cracked stone benches, a fallen bronze brazier, moss and roots.

7.name: Crevice Vault
7.art: a small vault: a cracked wall with a dark crevice, collapsed stone shelves, broken clay jars, fungus growing in clumps, bear tracks in spilled dirt.

8.name: Pool of the Box
8.art: a flooded chamber (the dark water pool is already drawn; leave it exactly as it is): an iron-bound box on a small stone plinth at the edge of the pool, hanging vines, lily pads at the pool edge, a few bones.

9.name: Fungal Hall
9.art: a large hall overgrown with giant pale fungus and glowing mushrooms in clumps, rotting logs, two collapsed dwarven pillars lying on the floor, bear bones.

10.name: Hall of Two Keys
10.art: an antechamber: on the west wall a massive stone double door with two golden keyholes (keep the west doorway clear), two kneeling dwarf statues, roots across the floor.

11.name: Ossuary
11.art: an ossuary: stone shelves of stacked dwarf skulls along the walls, a toppled bone pile in a corner, moss, a broken torch sconce.

12.name: Treasury of the Thane
12.art: a sealed treasury: stone chests with dwarven runes, stacked gold ingots on a stone table, a rack of rusted dwarven spears, a tall stone statue of an armored dwarf thane.

13.name: Spear Gallery
13.art: a gallery: wall racks of old dwarven spears, a row of small holes in the walls, a toppled weapon stand, roots and moss.

14.name: Tomb of the Darkspear
14.art: the great tomb: a huge stone sarcophagus of a dwarf thane in the center with its lid smashed aside, a black iron spear lying across it, a giant bear nest of roots and moss against the north wall, enormous claw marks, piles of bones.

15.name: Chamber of the Hovering Key
15.art: a small chamber: a carved stone ring inlaid in the floor in the center with a small golden key floating above it surrounded by faint golden light, carved dwarven runes around the walls.
